resolver_host_dependency.ownership: Caller-owned getnameinfo buffers; separate owned addrinfo lists; stable unmanaged borrowed hostent storage on existing RuntimeThreadState, separate per-thread/context h_errno, next-lookup invalidation and existing context-disposal/finalizer cleanup
